events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: Yepoda K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Union Square
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's Dewy Day Tour stop at Sephora Union Square with K-beauty product trials, free gifts while supplies last, and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.what_is_free: Attendance requires no purchase. Exclusive free gifts are offered while supplies last; a separate gift-with-purchase is tied to qualifying Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. The Eventbrite listing is organizer-published by Yepoda and offers a free ticket/RSVP. No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the ordinary freebies; the separate GWP requires a qualifying purchase.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 12 PM–6 PM at Sephora Union Square, 40 E 14th St. The organizer also describes the activation as Broadway near E 13th/E 14th; use the Sephora street address for navigation.

occurrences.details: Free organizer-issued RSVP/ticket is the advertised admission path. Product samples/free gifts are while supplies last; no purchase is necessary to attend.
